title: Observe sidebar layout and keyboard behavior
body:
## Goal

Record sidebar show/hide, resize limits, focus order and shortcuts using synthetic tabs.

## Required environment

macOS Arc; repeat separately on Windows.

## Deliverables and acceptance

Original written specification with OS/build/date, reproducible steps, dimensions at a stated display scale, and tested edge cases. No Arc assets or screenshots required.

## Boundaries

Read AGENTS.md and docs/RESEARCH_POLICY.md. One focused PR; independently authored material only. No account sharing, auth bypass, personal profiles, proprietary assets or decompiled implementation. Record sources and checks not run. Research reports must use docs/templates/OBSERVATION.md and separate facts from hypotheses.

## Dependencies

None; ready to claim.

title: Bounded static analysis of workspace serialization references
body:
## Goal

Assess rights/terms basis before inspection. Trace only the two documented serialization candidates; maximum 64 KiB per selected span, 60 seconds per decompile, ten minutes total. Do not run whole-app analysis.

## Required environment

Local lawfully obtained reference matching the documented hash; Ghidra or existing parsers.

## Deliverables and acceptance

Original factual report distinguishing normal persistence from export/debug only if supported; hash, ranges, commands and uncertainties. Keep pseudocode, assembly and bytes local; negative result is acceptable.
